title: Algebraic concordance of links
summary: Algebraic concordance of knots can be understood from the perspective of Seifert matrices, Blanchfield forms, and homology surgery. We initiate a systematic study of algebraic concordance for links from each of these viewpoints. The present article is concerned with algebraic concordance from the perspective of homology surgery and Blanchfield forms, whereas a companion article by the third named author focuses on C-complexes and generalised Seifert matrices.
